transcript: Twenty thousand customers a day, each with a charge they don’t recognise.
Disputes follow a known path, so most of this is a workflow.
The agent borrows the customer’s identity, scoped and short-lived.
Four tools. Two read, two write, and the writes are capped.
Retrieved text steers the agent, so we control what gets retrieved.
The model can want anything. The policy engine decides what happens.
Big credits wait for a human who sees the evidence.
Four runs each. We ship on the worst case, not the best.
Every turn leaves a trace an auditor can read.
About six cents a conversation, before routing.
